title: COCOMI Convenor YK Dhiren Demands Resignation of Present Government, End to ‘Proxy War’
summary: COCOMI Convenor YK Dhiren demands the resignation of the present Manipur government, removal of Assam Rifles and NRC updation before the Census during a mass rally in Imphal.
body:
IMPHAL, October 31, 2026: Coordinating Committee on Manipur Integrity (COCOMI) Convenor YK Dhiren on Saturday demanded the resignation of the present government, alleging that it had failed to address the ongoing crisis in Manipur.

Addressing a mass rally organised under the banner of COCOMI, Dhiren called for an immediate end to what he described as a “proxy war” allegedly waged by Indian state forces against the indigenous community.

The rally began at Tiddim Ground and was scheduled to culminate at THAU Ground in Imphal.

Dhiren also demanded the removal of the Assam Rifles, alleging bias in its functioning. He further called for the updation of the National Register of Citizens (NRC) before the conduct of the Census.

The rally was organised to highlight the ongoing conflict, raise concerns over the protection of indigenous communities and demand accountability from the government and security agencies.

Through the demonstration, COCOMI reiterated its demands for an end to the conflict and steps towards restoring peace and normalcy in Manipur.
